lines: I count losses carefully. I can count an apology too, if it is real.
Rough hands ruin good wool. Gentle choices from here, yes?
A frightened heart remembers rough handling. Be gentler from here.
Fine. I'll count the apology, but I'll also count what follows.
Trust scatters quickly. Gather it patiently.
Don't chase forgiveness. Walk steady and let it come closer.
I hear you. Keep your hands calm around this village.
Words can be soft. Make your choices soft too.
Thank you for saying it plainly.
I am still hurt, but I would rather mend this than carry it.
Replace what you broke and we can begin again.
I need time before your apology feels true.
You frightened the flock when you swung that weapon.
I believe you regret it. I am watching what you do next.
Do not ask me to forget. Ask me for a chance to see better from you.
The apology helps. Giving me space will help more.
I can forgive a mistake more easily than an excuse.
We can speak again after my temper settles.
Tell the others you were wrong too, not only me.
I accept the words. The trust will take longer.
